summary: נֹאד is a skin vessel. David asks Yahweh to keep his tears in the divine skin bottle.

senses.definition: A leather vessel used to hold liquid, here an image for preserving tears.

note:
Drafted for Psalm 56 coverage.

Root (2026-11-21): Filed under its own consonants נאד, a root unused as a verb in scripture; the word has no prefix or ending to strip, and no other Hebrew word of these letters is attested.
